name: Destek Finans Faktoring AS
summary: Based in Istanbul, Turkey, Destek Finans Faktoring A.S. commenced operations in 1996, providing a variety of factoring solutions to corporate and commercial businesses across the country. Their services span domestic, international, and import factoring, in addition to vital financial assistance for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). The firm operates as a subsidiary of Destek Holding Anonim Sirketi.
